packages.name: Standard
packages.headline: A confident first impression.
packages.audience: For a business, campaign, or idea that needs one clear place online.
features: One custom static landing page, up to 6 sections
Responsive design using your brand, text, and images
WhatsApp, email, and click-to-call links
Page titles, descriptions, social previews, and sitemap
Image optimization and SSL setup
Two revision rounds and 30 days of bug fixes
packages.boundary: No admin dashboard, checkout, or custom backend. You supply the final copy and images.

packages.name: Business
packages.headline: Room for your business to grow.
packages.audience: For a growing company that needs more pages and control over its content.
features: Up to 6 designed pages with an editable CMS
Blog or news section and content-editor training
One enquiry form with email delivery
On-page SEO setup across included pages
Search Console and analytics configuration
Two revision rounds and 30 days of bug fixes
packages.boundary: One language. Copywriting, bookings, and bespoke integrations are quoted separately.

packages.name: Commerce
packages.headline: Turn browsing into buying.
packages.audience: For a shop ready to take orders and manage products online.
features: Storefront, product pages, cart, and checkout
Product and order management dashboard
Initial setup of up to 30 supplied products
One supported payment-provider integration
Product SEO, analytics, and store training
Two revision rounds and 30 days of bug fixes
packages.boundary: Payment-provider approval and transaction fees are separate. Delivery integrations and complex stock rules are scoped separately.

packages.name: Custom product
packages.headline: Built around the way you work.
packages.audience: For portals, internal tools, or a focused web-app MVP with its own business rules.
features: A defined core workflow with custom UI and backend
Authentication and role-based access where needed
Database and API development
Admin tools matched to the agreed scope
Deployment, documentation, and handover
Milestone reviews and 30 days of bug fixes
packages.boundary: A starting budget for a focused MVP, not an unlimited feature list. Mobile apps, AI usage, and complex integrations need a separate scope.

extras.name: Search visibility
extras.description: Keyword and page review, metadata improvements, structured data where appropriate, Search Console, and local-business profile guidance. Up to 5 existing pages; ongoing content is separate.

extras.name: Copy & content
extras.description: A focused landing-page copy package: headline, service descriptions, calls to action, and one review round. Photography, translation, and additional pages are quoted separately.

extras.name: Additional language
extras.description: Add supplied translated copy to up to 5 pages, language navigation, and language-aware search metadata. Professional translation is separate.

extras.name: Bookings & integrations
extras.description: One supported booking or external-service integration. Scope depends on the provider and your workflow; platform subscriptions are separate.

care.name: Website hosting
care.description: For a static or small business site. SSL, uptime monitoring, and weekly backups with 30-day retention. Domain registration and email subscriptions are separate.

care.name: Application hosting
care.description: A starting plan for a small CMS or web app, with SSL, monitoring, and daily backups with 30-day retention. Database size, traffic, storage, and resource limits are agreed in your quote.

care.name: Essential care
care.description: Monthly updates and health checks, backup checks, and up to 1 hour of small content changes. Hosting is separate. Larger features are quoted; unused time does not roll over.

care.name: Growth care
care.description: Essential care with up to 3 hours of content or small improvements each month, plus an analytics review. Hosting and ongoing SEO campaigns are separate; unused time does not roll over.
